hypotheses.M0_compact_write_modules_generalize_acro: For every target token, its frozen rank-32 FineWeb write subspace has fidelity >=0.70 on every corpus.
hypotheses.M1_learned_modules_beat_random: For every target/corpus, correct rank-32 subspace fidelity exceeds an equal-rank random-subspace oracle by >=0.30.
hypotheses.M2_write_modules_are_operation_specific: For every target, mean correct-subspace fidelity exceeds a cyclic wrong-operation subspace by >=0.15 across corpora.
hypotheses.M3_native_channel_banks_are_operation_sp: For every target, mean fixed top-128 fidelity exceeds a cyclic wrong-operation channel bank by >=0.10 across corpora.
hypotheses.M4_fixed_native_banks_are_broadly_useful: For every target/corpus, its fixed top-128 native bank reaches fidelity >=0.60.
